label: NO GYM NEEDED
hook_sub: Ghar pe hi karo. Save it!

moves.name: Bodyweight *Squat*
cues: Sit back like a chair, heels down

moves.name: Static *Lunge*
cues: Feet split, drop the back knee down
Front knee stays over the foot

moves.name: Glute *Bridge*
cues: Lie down, feet flat, knees bent
Push through heels, squeeze at top

moves.name: Calf *Raise*
cues: Rise onto your toes, pause 1 sec
Lower slowly, hold a wall for balance

moves.name: Donkey *Kick*
cues: Kick heel to the ceiling, no arching

send: Send this to your leg-day buddy
